title: Fix pre-existing @flash/authoring-ui exportFrameFilename.test.ts: window is not defined
description: exportFrameFilename.test.ts fails in vitest with 'window is not defined'. The test was last touched in task 0817. Root cause: test uses browser globals without a jsdom environment. Fix: add a vitest environment annotation (e.g. @vitest-environment jsdom) or mock window in the test file.
